criteria.text: Low back pain or lumbar radiculopathy has lasted at least 6 weeks and the patient has completed at least 6 weeks of conservative therapy (physical therapy, clinician-directed home exercise, NSAIDs or other analgesics, activity modification) without adequate improvement.

A red flag is documented: progressive or severe neurological deficit, cauda equina symptoms (new bowel or bladder dysfunction, saddle anesthesia), suspected spinal infection, suspected malignancy, or suspected fracture after significant trauma.
A physical examination including a neurological examination of the lower extremities (strength, reflexes, sensation, or straight leg raise) is documented within the 30 days before the request.
Knee X-rays show advanced arthritis: Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3 or 4, or severe joint space narrowing with osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis, or bone-on-bone contact.
Moderate to severe knee pain with functional limitation that interferes with activities of daily living such as walking, climbing stairs, standing, or sleeping.

At least 12 weeks of documented non-surgical treatment (physical therapy or supervised exercise, NSAIDs or analgesics, corticosteroid injections, weight loss, assistive devices or bracing) without adequate relief.
Advanced joint destruction where non-surgical treatment would not help: avascular necrosis of the femoral condyle or tibial plateau, collapse of the joint surface, or severe fixed deformity.

Symptoms suggestive of a sleep disorder are documented, such as loud habitual snoring, witnessed apneas or gasping during sleep, or excessive daytime sleepiness (e.g. Epworth Sleepiness Scale score greater than 10).

groups.description: Reason for an in-lab study (at least one)

criteria.text: A home sleep apnea test was performed and was negative, inconclusive, or technically inadequate, and clinical suspicion of obstructive sleep apnea remains.

The patient has a condition that makes a home test inappropriate: moderate to severe pulmonary disease, neuromuscular disease, congestive heart failure, or a suspected sleep disorder other than obstructive sleep apnea (narcolepsy, periodic limb movement disorder, parasomnia).
